prompt:

Header text verbatim: "uppriktig". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "sincere".
Scene: Adult woman apologizing face to face with hand to chest, attentive friend, natural earnest expression, no text bubbles.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "uppriktig = sincere; expressing what you truly feel.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon ger en uppriktig ursäkt.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
